LESSON: PILLARS OF ISLAM

Grade: PP1
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: DEVOTIONAL
Topic 3.1: Pillars of Islam

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Pillars of Islam. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: what they have heard 2. Who says the shahadah?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. recite correctly the shahada Al- wahid (Suggested time: 3 lessons) Islam
2. demonstrate love for Allah (S.W.T) by exalting His name with the phrase ‘Subhanahu wa taala’ when mentioned
3. demonstrate love for prophet Muhammad by praising him with Swalallahu Aleyhi Wassalaam when his name is mentioned

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. recite correctly the shahada Al- wahid (Suggested time: 3 lessons) Islam
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to recite correctly the shahada Al- wahid (Suggested time: 3 lessons) Islam. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. demonstrate love for Allah (S.W.T) by exalting His name with the phrase ‘Subhanahu wa taala’ when mentioned
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate love for Allah (S.W.T) by exalting His name with the phrase ‘Subhanahu wa taala’ when mentioned. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. demonstrate love for prophet Muhammad by praising him with Swalallahu Aleyhi Wassalaam when his name is mentioned
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate love for prophet Muhammad by praising him with Swalallahu Aleyhi Wassalaam when his name is mentioned. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Pillars of Islam.
2. Explain Pillars of Islam to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Pillars of Islam.
4. Show that you can: recite correctly the shahada Al- wahid (Suggested time: 3 lessons) Islam
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Pillars of Islam. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: what they have heard 2. Who says the shahadah?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. recite correctly the shahada Al- wahid (Suggested time: 3 lessons) Islam
2. demonstrate love for Allah (S.W.T) by exalting His name with the phrase ‘Subhanahu wa taala’ when mentioned
3. demonstrate love for prophet Muhammad by praising him with Swalallahu Aleyhi Wassalaam when his name is mentioned

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
